shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Iran's Intelligence Ministry said it recently dismantled three terrorist groups linked to the U.S. and Israel in Alborz, Kerman, and West Azerbaijan provinces, arresting and killing several militants in the operation.

title: Iran Says It Dismantled Three Terrorist Cells Linked to the U.S. and Israel
